FLASHCARD SET · AGES 4–5

Prepositions & position words — the parent shelf: 22 cards to download and print.

The whole position deck for printing at home: twenty-two position-and-direction word cards for ages four to five, each with its try-it job, its three pills — age, subject, level — its download button and one-tap printing; the library is the parents’ side of the class, so everything happens on this one shelf.

This is the parents’ copy of Class 44 · Position & Direction Words: all twenty-two position word cards on one shelf, ready to print. You do not need a plan — pick the word today’s game needs, download the card, and print it full size on A4 or Letter paper. Every card carries one try-it job underneath and four pills on top: the age it suits, the subject it teaches, the grade level to start at, and the skill it builds. The download button takes the full-size card; the print button runs a single card through your printer with nothing else on the page. There are no card pages to hop through: the shelf is the whole set.

The shelf is yours; the lesson is your child’s. The class page at Prepositions for kids teaches each word the way a teacher would — spoken to your child, the word shown five labeled ways, one thing to try today — while this wall simply holds the deck for printing. Same twenty-two cards, two jobs: the lesson lives in the class, the library is where parents print.

THE THREE LEVELS

Preschool, Grade 1, Grade 2.

Every card wears a level pill so tonight’s card takes one glance to choose. The levels are a suggested order, not a test — the word your game needs most is always the right card.

  1. 01

    Preschool · Name it

    the eight words to start with — up, down, on, above, below, inside, outside and near — the ones a four-year-old already acts out every day.

  2. 02

    Grade 1 · Do it

    the seven doing words — over, under, next to, in front of, left, right and far — each one with a job your feet can finish.

  3. 03

    Grade 2 · Own it

    the seven bigger words — across, around, through, toward, away from, back-behind and between — the direction words that grow into map skills.

THE UP & DOWN SHELF · 7 CARDS

Words your body already knows.

Printable position word flashcards for preschool and up: up, down, above, below, over, under and on — the first positional words kids act out with their whole bodies, one card each with a way to try it today. Download takes the full-size card; Print runs just that one card through the printer.

THE WHERE THINGS ARE SHELF · 6 CARDS

Inside, outside, in between.

Where-things-are flashcards for ages 4–5: inside and outside, between and next to, in front of and back-behind — the position words that turn "where is it?" into a game a four-year-old wins. Download takes the full-size card; Print runs just that one card through the printer.

THE WAY THINGS MOVE SHELF · 5 CARDS

Direction words with feet on them.

Printable direction flashcards: across, around, through, toward and away from — movement words for preschool and kindergarten that turn the hallway into an obstacle course of words. Download takes the full-size card; Print runs just that one card through the printer.

THE SIDES & DISTANCE SHELF · 4 CARDS

Near, far and your two sides.

Left and right, near and far — the comparison words that grow into map skills, dancing directions and crossing the street safely, each on its own printable card. Download takes the full-size card; Print runs just that one card through the printer.
